subject: 南京栖霞寺舍利塔
caption: 栖霞寺 · 舍利塔
五层石塔 · 南唐重建
source_note: 真实石塔全景核对五层密檐、石塔刹、塔身浮雕、仰莲与束腰基座；移除四周栏杆及邻殿。浮雕简化为疏线轮廓，非逐尊测绘。

Image 2 is an actual photograph of the NAMED MONUMENT and is GEOMETRY ONLY.
Create sparse fine BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, all surfaces and openings WHITE. Confident thin exterior contours and fewer finer interior structural lines. No solid black fills, no shadows, no gray shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, texture or gradients, no color. Simplify repetitive ornament; do not trace every brick, tile, rafter or weathered patch. Roof and wall surfaces should stay predominantly blank. Preserve the actual identifying geometry, proportions and present condition. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences, surrounding buildings and sky. No text, calligraphy, labels, captions, dimension marks, watermark or border. A few short ground strokes only.
Portrait 1024x1536, whole tower and base occupy about 82% of canvas height with margins, full apex and footings uncut; centered near-frontal with minimal perspective.
SUBJECT: the stone Sarira Pagoda of Qixia Temple, Nanjing, the SOUTHERN TANG existing tower. Exactly FIVE octagonal eave roofs above the lotus-supported main body, not seven and not nine. This is a compact carved STONE tower: a broad low octagonal stepped base; a narrower pedestal carved in shallow relief; a large raised lotus-bowl molding; a tall octagonal first storey with vertical deity-relief panels and a blank central door face; then five distinct stone eave roofs stacked with short diminishing storeys. The FIRST roof sits immediately on top of the tall relief-carved main storey; the other FOUR roofs step upward above it. Preserve the bulbous short carved stone lotus/bud finial shown in the photo; no long iron rings. Preserve the roof corner curls, shallow curved stone roof profile, and recognizable small simplified relief silhouettes on the first storey and pedestal. Do NOT cover the tower in dense surface texture: leave carved figure bodies and robe regions mostly white with a handful of thin contours. Retain existing wear and chipped edges selectively, not a pristine imaginary replacement. Remove surrounding railings, neighboring halls, tourists and trees. Copy the full tower, finial and low base as seen; near frontal/slight oblique, centered, no crop. Five roofs are immediately countable.

historical_sources.supports: 现存舍利塔为南唐重建，隋代为前身，寺院489年创建与石塔主体不同。

site_recommendation.name: 栖霞寺舍利塔
site_recommendation.year_note: 960为南唐时期的近似排序位置，并非有确切铭文证实的施工年；不取隋代前身或寺院创建年代。
site_recommendation.place: 江苏 · 南京 · 栖霞
site_recommendation.lede: 栖霞寺舍利塔以仰莲托起雕像塔身，五层石檐向上收分，顶端立雕刻塔刹。佛龛、力士与基座故事浮雕，让这座南唐石塔同时保留建筑与雕刻两种尺度。
facts: 现存石塔为南唐重建，国保年代列五代；隋代木塔前身与今日石塔分开记录。
塔为八角五层密檐式石塔，下承须弥座与仰莲，塔身上方叠出五重石檐。
塔身雕有门与天王、力士等形象，基座刻佛教故事；图版将浮雕作简化线描。

quality_check.notes: 五层石檐、短石塔刹、莲台与最下台阶完整；白底无填色，移除环境栏杆。
